texto: Mom, chocolate at ten at night?
Relax, I'm baking cookies tomorrow. Baking soda's right here.
She's been saying this for months. Mom, tell them what you told me.
Oh God, you're filming again?
Fine. Listen, ladies.
This one box does more in my kitchen than half the stuff under my sink.
Cookies, pancakes, the fridge, the sink. One box handles all of it.
Mom, show them the before picture.
So where'd you learn that trick?
My grandma. A spoon of baking soda, a splash of water, let it sit, then scrub. That's it.
And no, this isn't the trick. This is just lemon water. The baking soda stays in the box.
Who even says that? Not this lady.
It's for baking, cleaning, and keeping the fridge smelling fresh. Simple stuff.
Mom, you've tried every cleaner online.
I tried literally everything. Sprays, foams, wipes.
None of those worked long term. Don't even get me started on the smell. Or the price tags.
Honestly, her kitchen's a different place.
Since the start of the year, the oven's clean, the fridge smells fresh, and I stopped buying ten different sprays.
Tell them what Grandma said.
When she saw my oven, Grandma literally said, don't change a thing. Okay.
I'll admit it, hers actually works. The expensive stuff doesn't.
One spoon for the cookies, one for the fridge, one for the pan.
It's La Baleine, all purpose and food grade. Keep one box handy.
Follow for more of Mom's kitchen tricks, and try the paste trick this weekend.
Do it the right way this time.
